verdict.rationale: Zamzar documents a free test option with no card required and a dedicated sandbox endpoint (sandbox.zamzar.com) separate from production, so developers can exercise the conversion API before paying. However, the evidence does not explicitly confirm that sandbox jobs produce real converted output, and the lowest tier appears capped at a 1MB maximum file size. missing for 10: explicit confirmation that sandbox or free-tier jobs perform real conversions, documented free credit or quota limits, the 1MB file-size cap on the entry tier, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, a free tier, trial, or sandbox lets me test real conversions before paying

citations.quote: All example requests are made to `https://sandbox.zamzar.com/`. If you want to use the production environment change the endpoint to `https://api.zamzar.com/`.
